notes: UX-01 Batch 3 - shared learner/manager UI for 'Hồ sơ đánh giá' on top of the Batch 1/2 backend (getChecklistAssessmentProfile). New path-based routes /hv/checklist/ho-so-danh-gia and /ql/checklist/ho-so-danh-gia (registered in ROUTE_REGISTRY/PHF_ROUTE_MAP, ride the existing checklist dispatcher, F5-safe). Learner gets one entry-point button (no target selector, no target ever sent). Manager gets a sidebar item plus an in-content quick-action (the sidebar is hidden on mobile - the in-content button is what keeps the screen reachable on phones) gated on grant.capabilities.view_monthly; target picker reads only server-scoped allowedTargets, never a separate company-wide fetch, and truncates to 50 rows with search. Shared assessmentProfileUiState reset is hooked into the existing resetRoleWorkspaceForOwner() identity boundary (logout/login, learner<->manager switch). Loader uses a requestToken+ownerKey race guard (mirrors the roleWorkspaceState pattern already in this file, no AbortController precedent to break). On a 403/404 for a chosen target the UI clears stale data, toasts, and falls back to self (refetches allowedTargets). Standard/current-score/history render independently per their own status field (standard.status='error' cannot blank history and vice versa); not_started/none never render a fake 0 score; 'expected' standard is explicitly labelled as a preview, never presented as official. No backend/permission logic touched (Batch 1/2 untouched, re-ran 33/33 PASS), no admin menu/route added. Regression: new scripts/test-checklist-assessment-profile-ui.js (structural, same source-scanning approach as test-checklist-permissions-tab-guard.js) covers route registration, role-gated menus, no-admin-surface, learner never sending a target, request-race guard, owner-scoped reset, status-driven rendering, and the 403 fallback - 49 checks total.
